text:
maya: Quick check: hotpath perf sprint status — kernel + continuous batching + KV warmup. TL;DR: two blockers (kernel PR merge, KV prefetch failure) + one rollout gating question. @alex can you confirm PR #4523 is ready for merge?

alex: I can merge once CI finishes. there's one flaky e2e failure I want to investigate first, but it looks unrelated to scheduling logic. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4523 — ETA ~2h.

jun: the KV prefetch job is failing on our stress harness. error excerpt: `AssertionError: kv_cache miss after warmup (expected hit)
  at prefetch_worker.py:118` — looks like race in the warmup handshake when sequence window overlaps. I'm repro-ing locally.

lina: FYI noticed an alert from perf-monitor for 99th latency spike at 10:23 PDT tied to hotpath canary. not customer-facing yet but trending. tagging @ryan for gating. :warning:

devon: possible short workaround: flip prefetch.enabled -> false in the canary config, re-run canary, then merge kernel once green. We'll lose the warmup perf for a bit but avoids client impact. I can prepare a rollback patch.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: hotpath-canary-2026-03-18-12:38 (id: c-7742). status: running checks.

ryan: I can own gating and the canary checklist. need access to canary logs and the prefetch flag dashboard. @maya can you add me to the canary group?

tess: I can run an extended stress job on staging for the prefetch scenario (15m run). if @jun can share the failing input set I’ll kick it off now. ETA ~20m.

maya: plan: (1) @jun share failing repro artifact in this thread (jun -> attach link), (2) @tess run extended stress and report, (3) @devon stage prefetch=false patch on canary if stress reproduces, (4) @alex hold merge until post-canary green OR we merge with devon's toggle as safety. @ryan you own gating + signoff. I'll update the sprint board after this thread. :white_check_mark:

jun: uploaded repro tarball: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/hotpath/prefetch-fail-1768012345.tar.gz — includes harness logs + minimal trace.

tess: kicked off stress: job id s-8821. I'll post results when done (20m).

alex: thanks — I'll keep PR blocked until we have clear canary status. if canary is failing because of prefetch, we can merge with the toggle as @devon suggested.

lina: adding a note for product: small perf regression might affect low-latency tier. @maya may want to loop in product-sla channel after signoff.

devon: prepping toggle patch now: gist https://gist.redwood/patches/ptoggle-1768012345 — small config diff. can apply as hotfix to canary.

deploy-bot: canary checks: initial health OK, background error rate rising to 0.4% (threshold 0.2%), telemetry flagged.

ryan: I'll wait for @tess results and then check logs. if error rate > 0.3% we rollback.

maya: thanks all. I'll create dependent PR links on the sprint card and set owners as above. please ping here once your step is done.

(edited)
